meta.note: Interim naming set while awaiting Jenny’s own name ideas. Shortlist favorites; leave room to fold her concepts into a second round.
meta.brief: 20 full brand boards: name, wordmark/logomark direction, typography pairing, palette, tagline. Preserve path to keep Angel Face equity (Still Angel / Angel Face Regen) or fully rebrand.
howToUse: Agency deliverable name: brand identity territories (also called naming boards / identity exploratories).
Shortlist 3–5 territories that feel like Jenny — not just pretty logos.
When Jenny’s name ideas arrive, add them as territories 21+ without killing this round.
Do not hard-cut Angel Face SEO; any rebrand keeps dual-name transition for 6+ months.
Pair a territory with a homepage comp from §15 once both shortlists exist.

territories.name: Lumen Atelier
territories.typography: Geometric sans display + soft serif accent
territories.why: Elevates regenerative work without spa-deal energy; ‘atelier’ signals craft over volume.
territories.fit: Premium soft-season positioning; pairs with Gallery White / Soft Blush comps.

territories.name: Mapface
territories.why: Owns the rare MA ultrasound differentiator in the name itself.
territories.fit: Best if wedge offer stays ultrasound consult forever; bold vs local nurse sites.

territories.name: Still Angel
territories.typography: Refined serif wordmark + quiet sans body
territories.why: Soft rebrand that keeps SEO/equity while sounding more mature and clinical.
territories.fit: Lowest-risk path if Jenny wants change without erasure.

territories.name: Northlight Aesthetics
territories.why: Stoneham / North Shore signal without sounding small-town.
territories.fit: Local demand engine; answers Precision Nurse geo presence.

territories.name: Racioppi Regenerative
territories.why: Reviews already name Jenny — founder brand converts trust.
territories.fit: Mirrors Precision Nurse / MD Beauty personal-brand move.

territories.name: Soft Precision
territories.typography: Precise geometric sans + light italic accent
territories.why: Says the brand promise in two words — natural look + clinical skill.
territories.fit: Strong voice lock for ads and ultrasound education content.

territories.name: Clearface Clinical
territories.why: Anti-mystery medspa — education and safety as brand personality.
territories.fit: Pairs with Education Magazine / Ultrasound Map comps.

territories.name: Verdure Aesthetics
territories.why: Owns regenerative category language without wellness-woo.
territories.fit: Phase 4 holistic vision without abandoning injectables now.

territories.name: Harbor Regenerative
territories.why: Boston metro credibility with quiet luxury calm.
territories.fit: If Boston secondary market becomes more important later.

territories.name: Quiet Face
territories.why: Anti-promo, anti-badge — premium posture vs deal spas.
territories.fit: High-ticket membership / membership-adjacent positioning.

territories.name: Signal Aesthetics
territories.tagline: Guided by what we can see.
territories.why: Makes ultrasound the brand metaphor, not a footnote.
territories.fit: Younger / tech-forward patient segment; sharp vs pastel SERP.

territories.name: Ethos Atelier
territories.why: Matches Jenny’s teaching instinct and first-timer calm path.
territories.fit: Content-led brand; courses / workshops later without rebrand.

territories.name: Lucent Face
territories.tagline: Light on the face. Heavy on skill.
territories.why: Beauty-forward without losing clinical credibility.
territories.fit: Lip / skin quality storytelling; editorial photography.

territories.name: Anchor Aesthetics
territories.why: Stoneham-first demand story made literal and trustworthy.
territories.fit: Reactivation SMS + GBP local SEO naming clarity.

territories.name: Form & Fidelity
territories.why: Sounds like a specialist studio, not a laser mall.
territories.fit: Filler / structure work storytelling; premium craft patients.

territories.name: Kindface Clinic
territories.why: Matches first-timer review language — calm, kind, not pushy.
territories.fit: Strong for referral scripts and soft-season reactivation tone.

territories.name: Prim Aesthetics
territories.why: Short, ownable, fashion-adjacent without losing clinic feel.
territories.fit: Memorable one-word brand if domain/socials clear.

territories.name: Ultraface
territories.typography: Modern dual-meaning U sans + clean body
territories.why: Name = category claim. Hard to copy without looking derivative.
territories.fit: If ultrasound stays the permanent North Star differentiator.

territories.name: Nest Clinic
territories.tagline: A careful place for your face.
territories.why: Intimate 1:1 Jenny experience — opposite of chain spa energy.
territories.fit: Membership / private suite vibe; Boemy-adjacent warmth.

territories.name: Angel Face Regen
territories.typography: Modernized Angel Face lockup + Regen subtitle
territories.why: Keeps search equity and patient recognition; adds regenerative signal.
territories.fit: Safest dual-name transition; good default until Jenny’s ideas land.
